# Sidrena legal automation notes

Sidrena 1.0.4 development line hardens publication settings so automated cjenik generation remains before the operational 08:00 publication deadline, archive retention stays at least 30 days, and machine-readable/public publication outputs remain enabled.

This engineering note is CI-visible context, not end-user legal advice.
